name: storybook-spread
title: The first rain (storybook spread)
description: One bilingual (English and Marathi), narrated spread of a Goan children's storybook: text beside the paus scene, word-by-word highlighting, always-present captions, and rain intensity driven by which words are playing, not the clock. Works without JavaScript: the story text and native audio controls and captions are always there.
